title: rosa canina var. bakeri
intro: Rosa canina var. bakeri, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose or dwarf wild rose, is a compact shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is a variant of the Rosa canina species, known for its small size and fragrant flowers. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. bakeri include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
